Theorem
[Gromov--Hausdorff closure and compactness] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0427 ↗ def:chow-iii-g35-g36-aleksandrov ↗ thm:chow-iii-g17-gromov-precompactness 1. appG:G.43–G.44\group Aleksandrov structure

The Gromov--Hausdorff limit of Aleksandrov spaces of curvature $\geq k$ is a complete length space of curvature $\geq k$. The family of spaces with dimension at most $n$ and diameter at most $D$ is Gromov--Hausdorff precompact.
